resource_title: circuitos_electorales_AR: circuitos electorales de la República Argentina
license_evidence: Pinned LICENSE and README at the adopted commit state CC BY 4.0 for the curated dataset. Upstream official source material may carry separate terms.
citation: Galeano, F. (2026). circuitos_electorales_AR: circuitos electorales de la República Argentina (Version 2025.1) [Dataset]. GitHub.

cross_vintage_code_compatibility_evidenc.note: These aggregate set-intersection counts characterize direct code compatibility only. They do not define or publish any 2021-to-2025 circuit equivalence.

reconstruction_evidence: The pinned README and CITATION.cff state that the dataset includes manually reconstructed circuits where official usable cartography is absent or incomplete, but the three-field source schema carries no exhaustive per-feature reconstruction flag. A8 therefore preserves curated_operational authority and records feature-level reconstruction status as unknown rather than inventing row attribution.
known_limitations: There is no single complete official national circuit polygon layer; this source is a curated operational compilation of heterogeneous official material plus documented reconstruction.
The pinned source schema does not expose an exhaustive per-feature reconstruction flag, so A8 cannot truthfully classify individual rows as official-versus-reconstructed.

Some logical circuits are represented by multiple source features because their territory is non-contiguous; A8 preserves source features and exposes a separate composite circuit_uid when the native composite key is complete.
Twenty-nine 2021 source features have null coddepto according to the pinned README; those rows are preserved with explicit incomplete-identity status rather than imputed.
coddepto is preserved as the source-native string, including source-native width; A8 does not pad, truncate, or reinterpret it as a Census department code.
Documented no-data and grey-zone polygons represent real territory without an assigned circuit and are preserved rather than filtered.
San Juan contains source GeometryCollection features; A8 preserves source geometry types and does not silently coerce or repair them.
Santa Fe and Tierra del Fuego changed circuit nomenclature between 2021 and 2025. A8 records aggregate code-compatibility evidence only and publishes no cross-vintage equivalence.

The pinned 2021/2025 GeoJSON is parsed feature-by-feature because at least one source geometry cannot be constructed by GEOS. A8 preserves the affected source feature, canonical geometry payload/hash and parse error with null analytical geometry; no repair or silent drop is applied.
Geometry precision varies, particularly where circuit boundaries were reconstructed from electoral decisions, polling places and political subdivisions.
A8 publishes geography only: no electoral results, Census relation, winner policy or cross-vintage crosswalk.
